Frame5: far leg supports beneath body; near leg swings forward from rear with knee bent. Frame6: near knee passes forward LEFT, far leg trails right. Legs visibly cross in passing poses; contact poses1 and4 clearly reverse WHICH leg leads, not just same silhouette mirrored. Arms counter-swing softly, torso slight natural bob. No floating, no running leaps. Only six figures total.
